matchData.veto:
1. Nemiga removed Inferno
2. TDK removed Nuke
3. Nemiga picked Ancient
4. TDK picked Mirage
5. Nemiga removed Dust2
6. TDK removed Anubis
7. Overpass was left over

badges.description: Old school: User been here for more than 10 years

text.text:
Expected result unfortunately. GGs to Nemiga!

I guess TDK have been praccing a lot of Mirage given how they chose that instead of Anubis when they had the opportunity, but it's still a shame imo despite them almost completing the comeback on it

Ancient was promising with a 7-5 lead, but they ended up losing a 4v2 in pistol which really seemed to put a dampener on them :/ Only 1 round on T-side shows that they need to improve a lot on their T-sides on this map (and on Mirage!)

Mirage was very entertaining, with them almost coming back from a 9-3 deficit, but unfortunately they fucked some easy rounds (lost to a half-buy on ct for instance). Losing 2 to a palace push last round really summed the game up for me. Some cool multis on Mirage though (ax1le and xant3r with sick multi side holds and nafany with a sick multi on t side)

It's also crazy how often artfrost plays these risky positions and gets caught out by a guy close to him.... I get he's posting good ratings but it really feels like team cohesion has dropped since he joined :(

Thunderpick and ESL Season 51 finals next! Please work on your t-side, guys!!
